text:
maria.cs: :wave: Heads-up — Novaterra is asking to onboard two additional teams (UX Research + Customer Ops) targeting mid-May launch. They expect a 3-4x increase in embeddings QPS and intermittent search spikes around product launches. Also flagged renewal in ~8 weeks; AE is concerned about capacity/enablement signaling renewal risk. Can SE + infra ops advise on Dedicated pilot timeline and quick enablement plan? Links: https://docs.redwood.example/novaterra/onboard-req

sam.ae: Thanks Maria — I can join the renewal call. Can we get a short doc with expected QPS, latency targets, and ideal timeline? I’ll loop in the account exec to surface renewal risk. :eyes:

lee.se: Quick Qs: are these new teams going to use embeddings for semantic search only, or also real-time chat/assist? Pattern matters for batching and KV cache sizing.

maria.cs: Main heavy use is embeddings for intent clustering + semantic search for UX prototypes. Some low-latency assist calls (~200ms target) for Customer Ops flows during peak windows. Estimated numbers: current embeddings steady ~20 QPS -> expected 80 QPS peak. Search throughput could hit ~800 requests/min during launches. Timeline: pilot start in 5–6 weeks.

jorge.infra: Noted. Dedicated capacity lead time ~3 weeks from order + config. For 80 QPS embeddings with caching/batching we recommend a 2-GPU pilot (A10G equivalent) with prefix caching + async batching; otherwise cost rises. Need batch size distribution and token lengths.

lee.se: Useful — if embedding batch size avg=32 and tokens per request small (<256), we can keep latency targets with batching windows ~20–40ms. Suggest we spin up a staging Dedicated pool and run a smoke test with their sample workload. Can we get a sample payload/ingest?

maria.cs: I uploaded a small sample payloads bundle: https://files.redwood.example/novaterra/sample-payloads.tar.gz — includes search qps simulator and embedding payloads. Also, summary doc with retention/PII questions.

ashley.pm: Happy to provide model/quantization recommendations. For cost vs. latency, we might suggest a quantized 8-bit embedding model variant and a higher-precision search model for low-latency hits. I’ll draft config suggestions and a rollout plan (canary -> full).

sam.ae: Action items: (1) Lee + Jorge to propose Dedicated pilot spec and timeline by EOD Thurs, (2) Ashley to share model recommendations, (3) I’ll schedule renewal sync with Novaterra CSM + exec. Maria — can you confirm who from Novaterra will own the pilot?

maria.cs: Point of contact is Priya (Novaterra, Head of UX) and Kofi (Customer Ops). I’ll intro after we have the pilot spec. Also they asked for a short enablement workshop for their engineers — 2 sessions: infra + best-practice prompts.

lee.se: I’ll prepare a 45-min technical runbook + checklist. Quick sample config to test locally:
```bash
# quick curl to simulate embedding upsert (replace TOKEN)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-8bit","input":["sample text 1","sample text 2"],"batch_size":32}'
```

jorge.infra: I’ll draft capacity ticket and cost estimate. If they want dedicated in EU region, lead time may be +1 week. Deploy-bot created ticket: #CD-8931 (Dedicated pilot request) — https://infra.redwood/tickets/CD-8931

deploy-bot: New dedicated-pilot request created by jorge.infra for account Novaterra — ticket CD-8931. Reminder: include security/contact list and expected data residency in the ticket.

maria.cs: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll follow up once we have the spec so I can intro Priya/Kofi and get the enablement calendar locked in. :thumbsup:
